verdicts.reason: The two candidates are the same layout apart from where the CTA sits. A's tighter headline-to-CTA gap groups them well and keeps the CTA clear of the bokeh dots. In B the CTA sits lower, where bokeh dots (at about x=283 and x=329) touch its text; that is an unwanted collision and the line reads less cleanly. Both share the same flaws: a bokeh dot sits against the 'E' of the SOLSTICE wordmark, the CTA is still small, unboxed orange text, and the bottom third is empty filler.
